title: Looking for advice for improvement
author: Guildbound
selftext:
I currently have a small community of returning players to my little project! It’s a fun little idle RPG in which gear is created not dropped we have a chain system for everything   
Mining > smithing  
Gathering>tailoring  
Skinning> leatherworking etc   
We have a nice little economy going returning players this is the my control tower where I see everything within the game I can see what players are doing most their time, their time played we have a few hardcore grinders!

But was wondering what I can do to improve the game that being said if it’s art ? Animations ? Storyline etc looking to really improve it. My end goal is to fully polish the game, release it on Steam for Free! With option to buy cosmetics that’s about it! Not thinking of getting rich but honestly have a game people remember and have fun playing 

I am willing to listen and improve it the best I can or if you provide proper tools or tips.
